nodes.description: Private owner address slot of Ownable; written in the constructor, renounceOwnership and _transferOwnership, read by owner() and isOwner().
Public 18-decimal market price written only by pushReport and returned by getData().
Caller-controlled address used to initialize owner and to authorize via isOwner().
Constructor that assigns _owner = msg.sender and emits OwnershipTransferred.
View predicate comparing msg.sender with _owner; backs the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0) and emits OwnershipTransferred.
onlyOwner function forwarding newOwner to the internal _transferOwnership helper.
Internal helper that requires newOwner != address(0) and overwrites _owner.
onlyOwner external function that stores the reported market price in currentMarketPrice.
Raw state mutation in pushReport assigning caller-supplied argument to the price slot.
Constructor state mutation granting ownership to msg.sender.
State mutation in _transferOwnership replacing the owner with the supplied address.
State mutation in renounceOwnership permanently clearing the owner.
Address parameter of transferOwnership, only forwarded to _transferOwnership.
Address parameter of _transferOwnership, checked against zero and assigned to _owner.
uint256 price parameter of pushReport, written directly into currentMarketPrice.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the value that determines initial ownership in the constructor assignment.
isOwner() authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender with _owner.
isOwner() reads the _owner state variable for the authorization comparison.
transferOwnership consumes its newOwner parameter in the function body.
transferOwnership internally calls _transferOwnership to complete the transfer.
onlyOwner invokes isOwner(); a failed check reverts transferOwnership before the state write.
onlyOwner invokes isOwner(); a failed check reverts renounceOwnership before the state write.
_transferOwnership consumes its newOwner parameter inside the internal helper.
The newOwner parameter directly supplies the value written into _owner.
pushReport consumes its currentMarketPrice_ parameter in the function body.
The currentMarketPrice_ parameter directly supplies the value written into the price slot.
pushReport executes the state mutation as its only guarded body statement.
The write operation mutates the currentMarketPrice state variable.
The constructor write initializes the _owner state variable.
The internal transfer write mutates the _owner state variable.
The renounce write clears the _owner state variable.
The constructor body performs the _owner = msg.sender assignment.
The constructor reads msg.sender as the untrusted source of ownership.
_transferOwnership executes the guarded assignment to the owner slot.
renounceOwnership executes the address(0) assignment to the owner slot.
owner() returns the value of the _owner state variable.
getData() returns the current value of currentMarketPrice.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter has no independent semantic identity; it is consumed entirely by transferOwnership and forwarded to _transferOwnership, so it folds into that core function node.
The parameter is the direct data source of the _owner = newOwner write, so it should be absorbed into the unsafe_operation node representing that assignment.
The parameter is assigned verbatim into currentMarketPrice by pushReport, so it collapses into the unsafe_operation node for that state write.
